description: Bottom sheet, drawer and modal sheet for the web: one gesture engine with snap points and spring physics, with adapters for React, Vue 3, Svelte 5, Solid, Qwik and Preact and a <bottom-sheet> custom element.
rules: Snap points are objects { id, size }; refer to them by id, never by index
A sheet that can close needs a snap point of size 0; the open prop, v-model:open and bind:open depend on it
Import '@surdeddd/bottom-sheet/styles' once; the <bottom-sheet> custom element does not need it
Do not set z-index on .bs-sheet, .bs-backdrop or anchors; use teleportTo to change the stacking context
Call cancel() synchronously inside before-snap and before-close handlers
Unmount a sheet on the closed event, not on close
A modal sheet needs both focusTrap and inertSiblings
backdropRange is a range of progress; backdropOpacity is the opacity
To scroll content with a finger at a half snap point, set fitContentToSnap and dragFromContent: false
The WebGL renderer (@surdeddd/bottom-sheet/webgl) is opt-in; do not add it unless the user asks for it
